info.name: PE Sub Platform
info.description:
REST API collection for the PE Subscription Borrowing Base Platform.

Services
â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  pe-sub-api         http://localhost:3001   Core API
  pe-sub-extraction  http://localhost:3002   Document extraction

Sync source: pe-sub-docs/openapi.yaml v0.10.0 and pe-sub-docs/openapi-extraction.yaml v1.0.0

Before running: update the collection variables (facilityId, lpId, etc.) to match your local seed data.

Authentication â€” stateless, header-based. In gateway mode every request must carry X-Auth-User and X-Auth-Roles (set the authUser/authRoles collection variables); a missing user header returns 401, an insufficient role 403. In dev mode (default local) the API injects a fixed dev identity, so the headers are optional and may be left as-is. The jobs feeds require SERVICE (POST /lpRecords/ingest, /lpRecords/seed, /facilities/ingest, /lp-master/ingest, /lp-master/clear, and PATCH /config/cls-conc-limit-defaults). Shadow BB review (POST /submissions/{id}/accept and /reject) requires MANAGER. Config, field-mapping, LP Master curation and BB template mutations require ANALYST. VIEWER is read-only: every GET under /api is open to any authenticated role, and all remaining writes are denied. Public routes (/ping, /health, /notifications/**) carry no headers.

request.description: The Shadow BB screen autosave/final save. Rows match persisted records by (facilityId, originalName || name); unmatched names are ignored. Present LP fields update in place. Blank cls is preserved as Unclassified rather than defaulting to Eligible. request.description: Computes and persists a new shadow BB snapshot for the facility (server-authoritative engine). An optional JSON body { lps: [...] } upserts LP input rows first — identity, classification, ratings, commitments, rates, concentration limits; engine outputs (abb, ubb, excess concentrations, rank) are not accepted and are computed and written back to lp_records by the server. Body-less POST re-runs over persisted records. Returns the snapshot with per-LP computed values incl. pctAgentBB/pctUbsBB/agentExcessM and the extended summary (totalUEC, totalUC, totalConcExcess, reclassCount).

request.description: ANALYST-gated. Imports a structured *.xlsx (sheets: Template with one data row, Tabs, Groups). mode=create rejects a duplicate template_slug; mode=upsert replaces it in place, which is how pe-sub-jobs pushes its watched data/bb-templates/ directory idempotently on startup and rescan. 201.

request.description: ANALYST-gated. Profiles an unseen Agent BB workbook into a proposed template — header row, columns, tab layout, agent/title clues, LP-category groups — for the operator to review and save via Create. Deterministic, no AI, and persists nothing. Every field carries a confidence and the evidence behind it. 502 when pe-sub-extraction is unreachable.

request.description: Applies many accept/reject decisions in one request and transaction — what the Match Queue fires on a bulk Accept/Reject instead of N per-row PATCHes. A non-blank masterName forces the decision to Accepted and re-resolves routing. The literal "decisions" segment is matched ahead of {id}, so it never collides with the single-item PATCH.
